name: VoltLine SpineBurst SB-7 'Hedgehog'
description:
A vest with retractable polymer spines embedded in the outer surface of the back and shoulders — the areas most commonly targeted in rear-approach assaults. When the wearer activates the system via a squeeze switch in either hand, twenty-four spines extend 3 centimeters from the vest surface. The spines are blunt-tipped polymer rods coated with a contact irritant — they do not puncture skin but deliver a sharp poking pain combined with a chemical burn sensation that makes grabbing or holding the wearer intensely unpleasant.

VoltLine designed the SB-7 to address the most common assault vector in GLMZ: the rear approach. Analysis of security footage from thousands of street assaults showed that the majority begin with a grab from behind — shoulder, collar, hood, or backpack strap. The SB-7 makes all of these grab points hazardous. The spines retract automatically when the squeeze switch is released, allowing the wearer to sit, lean against walls, and interact normally when the system is not active.

The vest is worn under an outer layer and is invisible when the spines are retracted. When extended, the spines are visible through thin outer garments but not through jackets or coats. The contact irritant coating lasts approximately ninety days before requiring reapplication — VoltLine sells recoating kits for Φ25. The vest itself costs Φ310 and is available in sizes that accommodate a range of body types.
specifications: spine count: 24 spine length: 3 cm extended spine tip: blunt polymer with contact irritant coating irritant duration: burning sensation for 10-15 minutes irritant recoating interval: 90 days activation: squeeze switch (either hand) weight: 280 g cost: Φ310 (vest), Φ25 (recoating kit) spine retraction: automatic on switch release
tactical_use: Activate the spines when you sense a threat approaching from behind. The spines make it painful to grab, hold, or restrain the wearer from behind. If grabbed before activation, the sudden extension of spines into the attacker's grip is startling enough to cause involuntary release. After the attacker releases, the irritant coating continues to cause pain for ten to fifteen minutes, discouraging re-engagement. Turn to face the attacker after the initial grab is broken to deny further rear access.
cultural_context: The SB-7 has contributed to a growing culture of 'defensive dressing' in GLMZ — choosing clothing based on its protective capabilities rather than purely its appearance. The vest is popular among people who work in exposed environments: street vendors, transit maintenance workers, and anyone who regularly has their back to public space. The visible spine extension has also been adopted as an intimidation display by some wearers, activating the spines preemptively to signal 'don't try it.'
story_hooks: The contact irritant used on SB-7 spines has been found to cause permanent skin discoloration in individuals with certain genetic profiles — VoltLine claims the correlation is not causation, but affected communities disagree.
A street-level modification replaces the SB-7's blunt polymer spines with sharpened metal ones — turning a defensive deterrent into a concealed weapon that causes serious puncture wounds.

physical_description.visual_profile: A fitted tactical vest with a sleek, minimalist silhouette when inert. The back and shoulder panels have a subtly ribbed texture hinting at the retractable spine mechanism beneath. When activated, it transforms into a defensive porcupine—24 blunt polymer spines bristling outward at 3cm intervals across the upper back and shoulder blades, creating an aggressive defensive posture.
physical_description.dimensions: Vest body: 58cm length (shoulder to waist), 42cm width (armpit to armpit). Extended spines project 3cm from surface. Available in XS to 3XL sizing.
physical_description.weight_description: Surprisingly light and balanced—280g total weight distributed evenly across the torso. Sits close to the body with minimal bulk, allowing natural movement when spines are retracted.
physical_description.primary_material: Core vest: reinforced polymer composite base layer with integrated mechanical spine channels. Spines: rigid polymer rods with injection-molded joints. Activation mechanism: lightweight alloy framework with synthetic squeeze switches.
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal polymer body with satin-finish spine rods. Contact irritant coating appears as a slight chemical sheen on the spine tips—barely visible but present under close inspection.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray primary with matte black accent panels around the spine deployment zones. Spine tips have a faint amber tint from the contact irritant coating.
physical_description.grip_texture: Squeeze switches embedded in vest side panels feature rubberized, textured grip zones for reliable activation with gloved or wet hands. Vest panels themselves are smooth-finished for comfort against clothing.
distinctive_features: 24 evenly-spaced retractable polymer spines across back and shoulders
Dual squeeze switches (left and right sides) for ambidextrous activation
Visible spine guide channels running vertically down the back when spines retracted
Amber-tinted irritant coating visible on spine tips under direct light
Subtle VOLTLINE brand embossing on left shoulder panel
Mechanical snap points where spines lock fully extended
Heat-dissipation vents between spine channels for extended wear comfort
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VOLTLINE PERSONAL ELECTRONICS logo stamped on left shoulder in raised relief. Serial number plate mounted on interior center panel with manufacturing date. Care instructions and irritant recoating schedule printed on interior back panel in eight languages.
physical_description.condition_typical: Generally clean and well-maintained in working-class use (Tier 2-3). Spine rods show minor scuff marks from deployment cycles. Contact irritant coating gradually dulls to a pale yellow-brown over the 90-day recoating interval. Frequent users may show wear patterns on squeeze switches from repeated activation.
